text: At its meeting on September 14, 15 and 18, 2023, the Nominating Panel – Committee of Adjustment considered Item NA2.1 and made recommendations to City Council. Summary from the report (August 30, 2023) from the City Clerk: The Nominating Panel - Committee of Adjustment will conduct interviews and recommend 35 candidates to City Council for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment.

City Council on October 11 and 12, 2023, adopted the following: 1.
